standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Base render with strong prompt adherence and stable likeness. Works for most scenarios.

premium.label: Premium
premium.description: GPT Image 2 on the high-quality branch (more reasoning steps, finer face and texture rendering) plus a separate Clarity Upscaler pass that doubles the resolution. Composition and face identity stay locked. If the premium pipeline is unavailable, the generation fails with an error and all 5 credits are refunded automatically — there is no silent downgrade to Standard.
